name: task_evidence_read
description: Read evidence for one task. The default source=progress refreshes and returns its bounded phase/checkpoint snapshot for diagnosis. source=delivered reads the full persisted status and payload without collecting, refreshing progress, or integrating; available after collection and context compression. Use task_audit for all recorded IDs. Reading never acknowledges integration.

task_id.description: Exact task_id returned by task/task_spawn/task_spawn_batch or listed by task_audit. Delivered lookup preserves the ID verbatim.

source.description: progress preserves the existing live snapshot behavior; delivered performs a read-only lookup of a previously delivered result.
